description: Defines a singleton object 'WakeWords' containing constants and utility functions for processing wake words, including parsing and sanitizing input strings.

methods.name: parseCommaSeparated
methods.description: Splits an input string by commas, trims whitespace, and filters out empty strings.

methods.name: parseIfChanged
methods.description: Parses input and compares with current list; returns the new list if changed, otherwise null.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Cleans a list of words by trimming, filtering, limiting length and count; returns defaults if the resulting list is empty.
